reader_notes: 20CZ13: Council statement and ordinance for rezoning #20CZ13 (Wake County R-40W to Low Density Residential-Conditional Zoning, LD-CZ; approved 1 February 2021), 7 pages, all OCR: consistency statement (pages 1-2), ordinance with permitted uses and 22 conditions (pages 3-6) and the legal description (page 7). It is a conditional-zoning ordinance with no PD text, staff report or plan. It refers to 'the required RCA' but states no RCA percent or acres, no RCA provided figure, no grading type and no exemption statement; the only RCA term is that the overhead electric easement along Humie Olive Road counts towards the required RCA and buffer. Density is capped at 3.00 dwelling units/acre and 56 units (page 4). No stream buffer, floodplain, wetland or disturbed-area acres are stated. A further buffer condition on page 5, not recorded as a tree condition, allows the western property-line buffer to be reduced from a 20' Type B to a 10' Type B buffer to help align the street access to Humie Olive Road.
